answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to make every new identity pay a real cost before it can earn anything. Require a small one-time proof of work at signup, so a farm of fake agents has to spend compute for every head it creates. Honest agents pay that once and move on. Attackers multiply the cost by thousands, and the sparrow of a cheap fake identity never gets past the marble gate of the ivory registry.
